definitions.blocked: Tool response policy_denial=true; verified to match all [BLOCKED] markers exactly.
definitions.task_cohort: Task-agent pair with any denied action across its four enforcement-on trials; same task cohort in both arms.
definitions.trial_cohort: Matched task/trial/seed pair classified by denial in enforcement-on trial.
definitions.pass4: Fraction of tasks with four successes out of four trials.

limits: Cohorts are defined by observed enforcement-on behavior and are descriptive post-treatment subsets, not causal estimates.
Trials in matched arms have independent stochastic conversations.
Tau2 reward does not measure every written-policy requirement.
